After the August major game "Madden NFL 27" launches, Apple Arcade will add "two beloved puzzle games" to this ad-free platform in September.

"Block Blast!+" and "Art of Fauna: Cozy Puzzles+" will join Apple's gaming subscription service in September

Apple announced that the September Arcade update will bring two brand-new puzzle games to the platform: "Block Blast!+" and "Art of Fauna: Cozy Puzzles+". Both games will land on Apple Arcade starting Thursday, September 3.

From the gameplay screenshots, "Block Blast!+" will particularly appeal to players who enjoy Tetris-style gameplay.

On the other hand, "Art of Fauna" offers a more relaxed pace with "artworks inspired by nature".

As with all games on Apple Arcade, there are no ad interruptions and no in-app purchases. All content is included in the Apple Arcade subscription.

Apple also highlighted more new content coming to Arcade from tomorrow through the entire month of August:

You can read the full announcement here.

Apple Arcade offers an ad-free, no in-app purchases service, with a free one-month trial followed by a monthly fee of US$6.99. Through Family Sharing, a single subscription can support up to five users.

Each Apple One bundle subscription plan also includes Apple Arcade.
